start.unterzeile: We calculate expected values for upcoming matches and compare them with past results. This helps us spot unusual values and see how reliable they have been so far.
start.ranking_text: The most interesting deviations of the upcoming matchday.
start.ligen_text: Select your league and view all matches of the matchday.
start.vergleichen: How many goals, cards or corners can be expected? We compare the values of every upcoming match with the average for that league.
start.markieren: Clear deviations are highlighted. Using historical matches, we check how often similar patterns were confirmed – in other words, how often the actual match value was on the expected side of the league average. We explain the methodology
start.entscheiden: Whether for a chat with friends or when making your own predictions: you can see at a glance which matches stand out statistically and where a closer look is worthwhile.
start.bereit_text: In under a minute you know which matches stand out.
start.fan_text: I am a passionate football fan with a particular interest in the numbers and statistics behind the game. Soccer Intelligence combines my enthusiasm for football with my interest in data and new technologies. The project is also an exciting opportunity for personal development.

start.ergaenzt: Supplemented with matches of low signal quality.
start.seo_1: Soccer Intelligence is a platform for the statistical analysis of football matches in the Bundesliga, Premier League, La Liga and Serie A. We examine statistics such as goals, corners, yellow cards and shots on target in comparison with the league average.
start.seo_2: If match values deviate clearly from the usual level, we highlight them as standout statistics. We also use historical match data to check how often similar patterns in past matches were followed by an actual value on the same side of the league average, and derive the signal quality from this.
start.seo_3: This gives football fans and tipsters a data-driven overview of interesting matches before kick-off.
start.seo_3_fett: We provide transparent statistics, but no betting advice or predictions of winnings.

methodik_excel.titel: Soccer Intelligence – thresholds and signal quality
methodik_excel.hinweis: Statistical analysis of past matches. Not betting advice and no guarantee for upcoming matches.

regel.stark: Success rate of at least 60% and uplift of at least +8 percentage points
regel.mittel: Success rate of at least 55% and uplift of at least +5 percentage points
regel.gering: Success rate of at least 50% and uplift of at least +5 percentage points
regel.mindest: At least 50 matches, an uplift of at least +5 percentage points, a lower confidence limit above +2 percentage points and an advantage in at least two thirds of the seasons.
regel.schwelle: We test thresholds of 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30% and 35%. We use the threshold with the highest signal quality. If two thresholds have the same rating, we select the one with more matches. We recalculate the thresholds once per season.

erklaerung.trefferquote: Share of past matches above the threshold in which the expected result occurred.
erklaerung.vergleichswert: The same share across all matches in the league, regardless of the threshold.
erklaerung.spanne_links: Range of the uplift (95% confidence interval using the Wilson method), lower and upper limit. The fewer matches, the wider the range.
erklaerung.saisons_positiv: In how many of the analysed seasons the uplift was positive.
